title: Invertibility of a completed affine comparison realization
statement: Let $Y$ be Noetherian, $f:X\to Y$ proper, and $J,K$ quasi-coherent ideal sheaves. Assume $f$ is an isomorphism over $Y\setminus V(K)$ [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Fix an adjunction $f^*\dashv f_*$ [def-pc-module-pullback], a coherent formal $J$-system $G$, coherent $F$ on $X$, an isomorphism $\beta:f^*G\simeq F^\wedge$, and coherence of $f_*F$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. Let $\kappa:(f_*F)^\wedge\to f_*(F^\wedge)$ have $\pi_n\kappa_n=f_*(\pi_n)$ and let $\alpha:G\to(f_*F)^\wedge$ have $\alpha_n\kappa_n=\eta_{G_n}f_*(\beta_n)$ at every positive level. For an affine $U$, put $B=\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_Y)$, $R=\widehat B_{J(U)}$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], $L=K(U)R$, and let $Q$ be the ideal sheaf of $L$ on $\operatorname{Spec}R$. For any coherent $A,D$ on $\operatorname{Spec}R$, $c:A\to D$, and $B$-module limit-to-sections isomorphisms $e_A,e_D$ with $(\varprojlim\alpha_n)e_D=e_A\operatorname{Res}_B^R\Gamma(c)$, the restriction of $c$ to $\operatorname{Spec}R\setminus V(L)$ is invertible. No objects or isomorphisms are supplied by this assertion.

proof.text: Obtain the algebraized completed-affine adjunction model, giving Z,p,adjR,A0,F0,b,hD and the two comparison isomorphisms. Define D0 as the coherent pushforward of F0 and c0 as the unit followed by pushforward of b. This construction asserts no isomorphism of c0.

Apply the general tensor-pullback unit restriction theorem to p and the complement of Q.support. The restriction of the unit is invertible; functoriality preserves invertibility of b. Thus the restriction of c0 is an isomorphism.

The section isomorphisms eA inverse followed by eA0 and eD inverse followed by eD0 are B-linear isomorphisms between coherent section modules. Lift them to sheaf isomorphisms a and d by completedAffine_coherent_iso_lift. Noetherianity of B comes from the affine open of Y; Noetherianity of R and coherence give quasi-coherence of A.

Cancel eA and eD in the two limit comparison squares to obtain equality of restricted-scalar section maps of c followed by d and a followed by c0. Faithfulness of restriction of scalars removes that restriction. Naturality of the tilde counit and its invertibility for quasi-coherent A lift this equality to sheaf maps. Restrict it to the complement and cancel the restricted isomorphism d. This proves the requested restriction of c is invertible. The entire assembly is a complete Lean proof.

theorem formalComparison_completed_affine_restriction_isIso
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Y]
    (J K : Y.IdealSheafData) (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    (hV : IsIso (pullback.snd f (Scheme.Opens.ι K.support.compl)))
    (adj : Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f ⊣ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f)
    (G : CoherentFormalModule Y J) (F : CoherentModules X)
    (β : G.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f ≅
      formalCompletionSystem (J.comap f) F.obj)
    (h : RingedSpace.IsCoherent Y.toRingedSpace
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj))
    (κ : formalCompletionSystem J ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj) ⟶
      formalCompletionSystem (J.comap f) F.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f)
    (α : G ⟶ (completion Y J).obj ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj, h⟩)
    (hκ : ∀ n : ℕ,
      formalModuleQuotientπ J (n + 1) ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj) ≫
        κ.app (op n) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
        (formalModuleQuotientπ (J.comap f) (n + 1) F.obj))
    (hα : ∀ n : ℕ, α.hom.app (op n) ≫ κ.app (op n) =
      adj.unit.app (G.obj.obj (op n)) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map (β.hom.app (op n))) :
    ∀ U : Y.affineOpens,
      let B := Γ(Y, U.1)
      let R := AdicCompletion (J.ideal U) B
      let L := (K.ideal U).map (algebraMap B R)
      let Q := Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
        (L.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv.hom)
      ∀ (A D : CoherentModules (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) (c : A.obj ⟶ D.obj),
        ∀ eA : limit (G.obj ⋙ SheafOfModules.evaluation Y.ringCatSheaf (op U.1)) ≅
            (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap B R)).obj
              ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj A.obj),
        ∀ eD : limit (((completion Y J).obj
            ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj, h⟩).obj ⋙
              SheafOfModules.evaluation Y.ringCatSheaf (op U.1)) ≅
            (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap B R)).obj
              ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj D.obj),
          (lim.map (Functor.whiskerRight α.hom
            (SheafOfModules.evaluation Y.ringCatSheaf (op U.1))) ≫ eD.hom =
          eA.hom ≫ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap B R)).map
            ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map c)) →
          IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
            (Scheme.Opens.ι Q.support.compl)).map c)
